description: End one run granted with gate_create_run: its token stops working at once (403 run_revoked) while the app itself keeps working. Use it to stop an agent mid-job; grant a new run with gate_create_run if the work should continue.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

run_id.description: The run id: run.run_id in gate_create_run's result

name: gate_revoke_run
title: End an agent run
